sections.label: Singapore ASEAN Chairmanship priorities
sections.summary: As ASEAN Chair, Singapore will focus on collective resilience, innovation, unity, centrality, the ASEAN Smart Cities Network, and cooperation in cybersecurity, counterterrorism and people-to-people linkages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: As the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Chair this year, Singapore will focus on strengthening ASEAN’s collective resilience and promoting innovation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Our Chairmanship will emphasise the importance of ASEAN’s unity and centrality in the evolving regional architecture.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: A key initiative is the ASEAN Smart Cities Network to promote ASEAN’s connectivity and attractiveness as an investment destination, and to improve the livelihood of ASEAN citizens.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will also enhance ASEAN’s cooperation in areas, such as cybersecurity, counterterrorism and people-to-people linkages.

sections.label: Malaysia connectivity projects
sections.summary: With Malaysia, the Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail and Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link will give both sides a greater stake in each other's success.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: With Malaysia, connectivity projects like the Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail and the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link will give both sides a greater stake in each other’s success.

sections.label: Multilateral trade and agreements
sections.summary: Amidst rising protectionism, Singapore will work with partners in WTO, G20 and APEC to maintain a rules-based open multilateral order, and push RCEP, EU-Singapore FTA and Eurasian Economic Union negotiations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Amidst rising protectionism, we will work with like-minded partners in international groupings, such as the World Trade Organisation (WTO), Group of 20 (G20), and Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC), to maintain a rules-based and open multilateral order.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will push for progress on the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) and the European Union-Singapore Free Trade Agreement (FTA), as well as for negotiations with the Eurasian Economic Union.

sections.label: MFA monitoring regional threats
sections.summary: Amidst an uncertain external environment, MFA is closely monitoring potential threats to regional peace and stability, including trade wars, terrorism and the Korean Peninsula situation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Amidst an uncertain external environment, MFA is closely monitoring potential threats to regional peace and stability, including trade wars, terrorism and the situation on the Korean Peninsula.
